property_summary: For any pair of callers, c.oracle() must return the same configured oracle address (it is caller-independent); the mutant returns msg.sender, so two distinct callers observe different oracle addresses.
change_summary: Return msg.sender cast to IOracleProvider instead of the stored oracle address, so oracle() returns the caller's address instead of the configured oracle.
mutated_unit_code: function oracle() public view returns (IOracleProvider) { return IOracleProvider(msg.sender); }
